# 💳 Share Doc and Notify (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — a step-by-step recipe that shares a Google Docs document with edit access (`gws drive permissions create` with role writer) and emails the collaborators the link. Distinct from the sibling recipe email-drive-link (lot 31): that one sends a generic read-only Drive link; this one grants edit access and notifies. Also distinct from the sibling create-doc-from-template: that one builds a new document from a template first; this one shares an existing document. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the recipe assumes the gws-drive, gws-docs and gws-gmail utility skills are loaded and the gws binary is installed and authenticated; granting edit access is a real permission change — confirm the recipients before sharing. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
